epLog.choice: "Okay. Together. I'm not letting you walk into that house alone."
Bree. She texted: *can u come by. its about my aunt. its good news. i hate it.*
Mikey. He wants to get a beer. Mikey never wants to get a beer.
"Yeah. I think so. I think she's happy."
Don't signal anything. It's her hand. It's always been her hand.
"It's her call." And mean it. Let her answer.
Jules. All of it. From the start. Text Simone something true and terrible and go.
Read Grisha for her. You've watched every hand tonight. You know how he breathes when he has nothing.

almost_kiss.text: At 4:12 a.m. on the roof of Cardone Hall, you leaned in. She put her forehead against yours. She said, "Not like this." Neither of you moved until the sun came up.

assunta.text: Nonna's mother, Assunta DiNardo, "moved" once, in 1918, during the Liberty Loan parade. She pulled a child out from under a trolley. Nonna says it runs in the women of the family. Until you.

assunta_diary.text: Assunta DiNardo's diary: she did it more than once. Every time she came back a little older. On September 28, 1918, there was a man up the street who moved too, and raised his hand to her like a man at a window.

bells_both.text: At midnight on New Year's, the bells stopped for one second. He asked if you heard the bells. You said yes. Neither of you said what you meant.

brannigan_face.text: You memorized Brannigan's face on Halloween night. A scar through the left eyebrow. A chipped canine. A wedding ring on a chain around his neck, not his finger. He doesn't blink enough.

brannigan_list.text: Brannigan has a provisional file on the Blur.

brannigan_list9.text: Brannigan asked Mikey whether you get nosebleeds and feel the cold. He asked the RA for a list of every resident on the ninth floor.

brannigan_name.text: The Halcyon man in the gray polo is named Brannigan. He's asking the police for the fast kid's name, not the robbers'.

brannigan_voice.text: Brannigan spoke to you at McPherson Square: "When the nosebleeds start lasting longer than the minute, you call us. We're the only ones who'll know what to do."

bree_parade.text: Bree: the job is the Thanksgiving Day Parade. Teddy left at 4 a.m. Wednesday.

bree_scream.text: Bree heard something in the cold at 11:51:04 on the night of the Hitch, something from the sky, and her power keeps it. It sounds like a crowd breathing and a clock running the wrong way, and under it, laughing.

bruno.text: On Thanksgiving, Bruno Iannucci came to dinner on Mifflin Street with his grandson Dante.

bruno_b7.text: You gave Bruno Iannucci the layout of Building 7: the eighth floor, both stairs, the glass room, the ward.

bruno_halcyon5.text: At Teddy's funeral, you told Bruno Iannucci that Halcyon left the door open at the Navy Yard and waited. He said: "Then they owe me a boy."

bruno_jefferson.text: Bree: Bruno Iannucci sat with Halina at Jefferson and told her he knows her surgeon. "Five years on the list. I don't want you to wait five years." He asked about Bree's voice.

cab_smashed.text: Monday morning, Pop's cab, Liberty #2207, was found under I-95 at Columbus Blvd & Snyder with every window smashed. Pop says it was kids.

callum_over.text: On Sunday afternoon, Jules ended it with Callum. In person.

carmen_medal.text: Carmen Torres gave you a San Judas Tadeo medal. Saint Jude, patron of lost causes.

constance_started.text: In the chapel at Ravenscourt, Gran had Jules roll the ivory die on the altar. Six. "How many times?" "Every time." Gran said: "It's started, then."

costume.text: Your "uniform" for nights out: black hoodie, gaiter, Pop's backward Eagles cap.

dana_halcyon.text: You gave Dana Fiorillo the Navy Yard story, off the record: Femi Ojo, the study, the three holes in his hip, the deputy ME who retired to Boca.

dante.text: Dante Iannucci, 24, from Passyunk. The jacket from the Melrose. Grandson of somebody important. Vinnie drives him.

dante_cap.text: Vinnie: Dante remembers the cap. Pop's Eagles cap, on backward, on the kid under I-95.

dante_jules.text: You told Dante Iannucci the blonde across the street at Teddy's funeral was your girlfriend. He said: "Bring her to Sunday dinner at Grandpa's. In March."

dante_saturday.text: Dante let slip that Saturday is "a pickup." They're going to "have a conversation" with your father in his cab, somewhere quiet, with "a friend who keeps things still."

dante_thanksgiving.text: Dante Iannucci: "Forty-one thousand, by Thanksgiving. Or we have this conversation again."

ear_tell.text: Jules says you touch your left ear when you lie.

es_screen.text: In the glass room on the seventh floor of Building 7, the screens listed Halcyon's subjects by number. ES-17: KEARNEY, SALVATORE. ES-44: PEMBERTON, JULIET. "PRIORITY. DO NOT RECOVER. OBSERVE." A second pulse was scheduled for 00:51:04.

femi_card.text: Femi's last message: "M.R. ALIVE. RM 714. THEY CALL YOU 17."

femi_changed.text: Femi Ojo was in the zone at 11:51. Since then, nobody notices him. You can.

femi_dead.text: Femi Ojo died alone outside your door, 9-14, on Halloween night, while the party went on around him. Halcyon's cleaners did it. You were on the roof.

femi_halcyon.text: Femi was in Halcyon's study. He was scared of them. He came to your door to tell you something, and they killed him for it.

femi_phone_read.text: On the night of the vigil, you texted Femi's phone. At 11:14 p.m., it said Read. Someone has it.

first_kiss.text: On Halloween, on the roof of Cardone Hall, at 11:47 p.m., you kissed Jules Pemberton. She was dressed as the Liberty Bell.

first_night.text: Valentine's Day, 2027, in 9-04, after the rink. The first time.

first_rewind.text: In the frozen moment, you failed, and time ran backward to give you another try. You failed again anyway.

gran_sam.text: Gran: "Some families are lucky. Some are early. The early ones always go in for somebody else. Keep him close, child, and don't let the house collect from him."

halcyon_aperture.text: Inside Halcyon, a screen read APERTURE, counting down to 11:51. Below it: SUBJECT FIELD 1.9 MI · CONTAINMENT NOMINAL.

halcyon_beds.text: Vinnie counted 41 hospital beds delivered to the basement of Halcyon's Navy Yard campus on Monday.

halcyon_clinic.text: Halcyon set up a "cooling clinic" tent in McPherson Square and lured Heck there with a text from Marisol's phone.

halcyon_outreach.text: A Halcyon man in a gray polo is asking RAs in the blackout zone to refer students with nosebleeds, migraines, or cold sensitivity. $500 a referral.

halcyon_tablet_man.text: A calm man from Halcyon in a gray polo swept Broad Street with a tablet after the light.

heck_fire_grace.text: You told Grace a man who was on fire did this to you.

heck_heat.text: Heck runs hotter when the weather's hot. He can't turn it off.

jayden_cold_man.text: The boy, Jayden, called you "the cold man."

josiah_1876.text: Gran: when he was thirty-one, Josiah Pemberton stood beside a great engine when it stopped "for a heartbeat," and something stood beside him. He made an agreement he didn't understand. Every Pemberton since has been lucky.

jules_callum.text: Jules has a boyfriend: Callum Whitford, Penn Crew. He's nice. That's the problem.

jules_carmen.text: You told Jules about Carmen Torres. You said you were "too slow." You didn't say how fast you were.

jules_changed.text: Jules was changed in the Hitch.

jules_chapel.text: When Jules was seven, Hugh locked her in the family chapel at Ravenscourt overnight. In the dark, she could hear the house breathing. Gran found her in the morning: "Pembertons don't need to be afraid of the dark. The dark should be afraid of us." She has slept with a light on ever since.

jules_chose_temple.text: Jules says she's never broken a rule. That was the lie. She chose Temple, apparently over her mother's objections.

jules_covered.text: While Sam was under I-95, Rosa called Jules. Jules told her Sam had fallen asleep on the lounge couch with his calculus book on his face, and that she'd put a blanket on him.

jules_darts.text: On the Parkway, Jules walked down the middle of the frozen street through Halcyon's darts. Every one of them missed. Her nose was bleeding. You saw it, and you don't know what you saw.

jules_die_sixes.text: Jules's ivory die rolls nothing but sixes now.

jules_fall_test.text: At Ravenscourt, Jules let go of the reins over a four-foot wall to see what would happen. She landed on her feet. Mercutio didn't.

jules_fire.text: Jules knows you ran to the 15th Street fire to help. She doesn't know how you got there and back so fast.

jules_glass.text: The window came down on Jules in the Hitch, and every piece of glass missed her.

jules_handkerchief.text: You have Jules's handkerchief: white, ironed, JLP in navy thread. "Keep it."

jules_ivory_die.text: Jules carries an old ivory die from her grandmother. "It isn't lucky. Luck isn't real."

jules_light.text: Jules sleeps with a light on. She asked you to leave the desk lamp on. You didn't ask why.

jules_light_off.text: On the night of Teddy's funeral, in 9-14, Jules asked you to turn off the desk lamp. She sleeps with a light on. She didn't, that night.

jules_mifflin.text: Jules came to Sunday dinner on Mifflin Street.

jules_never_loses.text: Jules says she has never lost a game of cards. It was one of her truths.

jules_nothing_happens.text: Jules told you: "Nothing happens to me. I don't fall. I don't get hurt. Everyone calls it luck. I think it's the wrong word."

jules_parade.text: Jules will be in the sponsors' grandstand at the Art Museum steps on Thanksgiving morning. Her father's firm sponsors the parade.

jules_pop.text: Sam left the study night to help his father. He said he couldn't say more.

jules_saw_hurt.text: Jules saw you bleeding on the bathroom floor at 3 a.m. after Kensington. She saw the injuries.

jules_saw_nose2.text: Jules saw you bleed again in recitation, onto her handkerchief.

jules_text_whatif.text: At 12:58 a.m. on October 4, Jules texted you: "What if it was me." Nothing else.

jules_twin.text: Jules has a twin brother at Penn.

jules_two_sams.text: Jules saw Sam in two places at once on the ninth floor. One in a towel, one in his doorway.

kensington_shimmer.text: In the Slip, something over Kensington was moving. Nothing should move in the Slip.

lied_nik.text: You lied to Nik about the Slip. He didn't buy it.

lost_minutes.text: After the Girard job, you lost twenty-one minutes. You woke up on a curb on Ridge Avenue with frost on your sneakers.

lost_minutes2.text: You woke up on the Cardone roof at dawn with frost on your bare feet and no memory of going up there. Twenty-six minutes, gone.

luck_cost.text: Gran: the luck costs other people. "The house always collects. Not from us. Near us." Mercutio. Every time it goes your way, it goes someone else's way less.

man_across_street.text: A man across Broad Street had your face, older, scarred, missing his left ring finger. He put a finger to his lips. Then he was gone.

marisol.text: A Changed girl in Fishtown, Marisol Reyes, 19, could pop lightbulbs. She went to Halcyon's "wellness study" Tuesday. She never came home. Her mother got a text from her phone: "im fine staying w friends." Marisol never texts in lowercase.

mcpherson.text: Nik mapped it: the shimmer you saw in the Slip and the sound Bree heard come from the same place. The sky over McPherson Square, Kensington.

mikey_bree.text: On the Parkway, Mikey stopped a fake ambulance from taking Bree Kowal. He made them back off on live TV.

mikey_pop_dinner.text: Monday Oct 19: Mikey asked Pop about Dante Iannucci at the kitchen table. Pop told him, in front of Ma. At Sunday dinner on Oct 25, nobody ate.

mikey_task.text: Mikey has been assigned full-time to the PPD task group hunting the Broad Street Blur. A Halcyon consultant named Brannigan asked for him by name.

mutual_reveal.text: On the roof of Cardone Hall on January 22, you told each other everything.

nik_panic.text: Nik has panic attacks. He had one on the stairwell when he saw you bleeding.

nik_rutgers.text: Nik was going to transfer to Rutgers in the spring. He withdrew the application on November 2, so he wouldn't be "the guy who wasn't here."

nik_tracker.text: Nik built a map of every place in the city where people reported "the cold" since August. It clusters around Kensington, the Navy Yard, and Mifflin Street, with one odd point in Gladwyne.

nonna_felt.text: Nonna says she felt you "move" on Saturday night.

nonna_jacket.text: Nonna: "Saturday, near midnight, the clocks. Wear a jacket."

nonna_key.text: Nonna gave you an old iron key on a ribbon. "When it's time, I tell you what it opens."

owe_jules_favor.text: You owe Jules Pemberton one favor. Any favor. Her choosing, whenever she wants.

parade_freeze.text: At 9:41 on Thanksgiving morning, Teddy Kowal froze the Benjamin Franklin Parkway.

pop_jacket.text: Vinnie saw Pop in a back booth at the Melrose Diner with a young guy in an expensive jacket.

pop_owes.text: Dante Iannucci told you: your father owes his family $41,000, from a bad bet in 2009. "Saturday is Saturday."

pop_unknown_calls.text: Pop keeps declining calls from the same unknown number: a 215 number ending in 4471.

revenant2.text: At dusk on Mifflin Street, the man who stands the way you stand waited under the streetlight at the end of the block. Nonna saw him too. She crossed herself.

revenant3.text: On the night after Halloween, at 3 a.m., Nonna saw the man who stands like you under the streetlight at the end of Mifflin Street. He was crying.

revenant5.text: In the Slip on the Parkway, the man who stands like you walked toward you between the frozen balloons. "You can't carry all of them." You said: "Watch me."

revenant_glimpse5.text: At the dry dock at 12:51, for one frame, across the water, you saw a gray-haired man with one hand raised, like a man at a window. Then Teddy fell.

revenant_note.text: On the back of Jules's index card, under "When I know, you'll be the first," someone wrote in your handwriting: "Don't trust the lucky one." You didn't write it.

revenant_ward.text: On the eighth floor of Building 7, an old woman, ES-03, woke long enough to say: "The old man comes at night. He sits with us. He has your face."

rewind_voluntary.text: You can rewind on purpose now. You reach for the moment you want back, and pull.

sal_white.text: One of Bruno's men was found on the bottom step of the dry dock with his hair gone white overnight, saying "eleven fifty-one." Halcyon answered.

salvatore_dinardo.text: Nonna's older brother was Salvatore DiNardo (1931–1961). He could do what you do, and he never learned to stop. In December 1961 he went in after three children at a fire on Arch Street and came back an old man. He died on Christmas Eve at 11:51. You are named for him.

sam_at_girard.text: Who knows you were at Broad & Girard during the robbery

sam_in_zone.text: Who knows you were in the blackout zone at 11:51 Saturday, felt the cold, and have bled since

sam_no_reply.text: Jules texted "What if it was me." You read it at 1:09 a.m. You never answered.

sam_number.text: Teddy and Bree have your number.

sam_slip.text: Your secret: when the world stopped, you didn't.

simone_list.text: Simone keeps a list on her phone about Jules, and one about Sam. Jules added a line: "8. She knows about this list."

simone_two_lists.text: Simone has two lists. One was about you. The other one, she says, "isn't mine to tell."

six_ambulances.text: Six ambulances without unit numbers, staged on the Parkway on Thanksgiving morning.

slip_rescue_pop.text: You Slipped and carried Pop away from Dante's men under I-95.

slip_rules.text: When you Slip: the world stops, it's freezing, you're starving after, and your nose bleeds.

stasis.text: The touching Gritty can stop things. A stopped thing isn't cold or warm. It isn't in time at all, even in the Slip. You couldn't move it.

tablet10.text: You took a Halcyon tablet off a fake medic on the Parkway. On it, a list. Your face, labeled 17. And faces you know.

teddy_darted.text: On the Parkway, Halcyon's fake medics darted Teddy Kowal. When his hand left the street, the ninety seconds started.

teddy_dead.text: Teddy Kowal died at the bottom of the dry dock at the Navy Yard at 12:53 a.m. on January 23. He was twenty.

teddy_face.text: You saw the face of the one who stops things: about twenty, pale, tired eyes, a chipped front tooth, a Band-Aid on his knuckles.

teddy_lost_40k.text: Teddy let go of Frank Kearney's cab under I-95 and walked away from the Iannucci job. $40,000, gone.

teddy_mother.text: Teddy's mother, Halina Kowal, needs a kidney. The robbery money is for her transplant evaluation at Jefferson.

teddy_name.text: The one who stops things is called Teddy. The big one with the burning hands is Heck.

teddy_number.text: You have Teddy's number. The deal: if Halcyon comes for one of you, you call the others.

thermal.text: Halcyon put thermal cameras on the Parkway lampposts. The Changed run cold. They're looking for cold.

tolu_nda.text: Halcyon offered Femi's sister Tolu $250,000 to sign an NDA about the study. She gave you his green notebook, "NOTES FOR SAM K."

tolu_truth.text: You told Femi's sister, Tolu, that it wasn't an accident.

unstick.text: Under I-95 you got stuck in the Slip. You couldn't get out. You found your own footprints in the frost at the river's edge and don't remember making them. You pulled yourself out thinking about Jules.

vinnie_dante.text: Vinnie drives nights for "Dante from Passyunk." Twelve hundred a week, cash.

watch.text: Salvatore DiNardo's pocket watch, stopped at 11:51. Nonna says in the Slip it's the only thing that ticks. Hold it, and walk toward it.

wawa_guy.text: A video of you at the Wawa on Broad went viral. The internet calls you WAWA GUY.

weisz_strange.text: Dr. Weisz told the class the Corliss Engine stopped "for a heartbeat" in 1876. After class he told you your edges were blurry.

whatif.text: On the stoop on Mifflin Street, Jules said your brother was looking for the Blur. You said, "What if it was?"

xray.text: The x-ray at Temple ER showed fractures that were ten days into healing. You broke them the night before.

recap.t: You moved into Cardone Hall, 9th floor. You carried a minifridge nobody asked you to carry.
At 11:51:04 on Saturday night, every clock in North Philadelphia stopped. You didn't.
You pulled a little boy named Jayden out from in front of the 16 bus. He called you "the cold man."
A nine-second video went viral. The internet calls you WAWA GUY.
A man across Broad Street put a finger to his lips. Then a bus passed, and he was gone.
You told Nik everything. He wants to be your guy in the chair.
You finally went to see Carmen Torres. She gave you a medal of Saint Jude, patron of lost causes.
Three people in Gritty masks robbed an armored truck at Broad & Girard. One of them could stop things just by touching them.
The Inquirer has a new name for you: the Broad Street Blur.
Since Saturday, nobody can see Femi Ojo. Except you.
A rowhouse burned at 15th & Lehigh. Halcyon's men were waiting with dart rifles.
The night the power went out on the ninth floor, you and Jules talked until the sun came up.
Then Callum came with iced coffee.
Halcyon lured Heck to McPherson Square. You fought him to bring him home, and you did.
For the first time, you rewound time on purpose.
Brannigan knows about the minute.
Jules stitched you up on the bathroom floor at 3 a.m.
Your x-ray showed ten days of healing. You broke it the night before.
Jules came to Sunday dinner on Mifflin Street. Nonna handed her the macaroni first.
Mikey is on the Blur task group now. Brannigan asked for him by name.
Vinnie drives nights for a man named Dante, from Passyunk.
A man who stands the way you do stood at the end of Mifflin Street. Nonna saw him too.
At Ravenscourt, Jules couldn't lose a hand of cards, no matter what she did.
A physicist named Dr. Achterberg asked where Jules was at 11:51 on August 22.
Callum said "I love you." Jules said it back.
In the chapel at Ravenscourt, Constance watched the die come up six, and said, "It's started, then."
Pop owes the Iannucci family $41,000. Dante says: by Thanksgiving.
Under I-95, you got your father away from Dante's men.
Jules lied to your mother for you.
Monday morning, Pop's cab was found with every window broken.
On Halloween, Halcyon's cleaners killed Femi Ojo.
He died alone outside your door while the party went on around him. You were on the roof.
You kissed Jules on the roof at 11:47. You didn't look at your phone.
Brannigan knows your name.
Femi's last message: "M.R. ALIVE. RM 714. THEY CALL YOU 17."
Femi's phone read your messages. Someone has it.
Simone knows. You lied when she gave you the chance.
Teddy is planning one last job. November 26.
On the back of Jules's index card, in your handwriting: "Don't trust the lucky one."
On Thanksgiving, Teddy Kowal froze the Parkway. Halcyon came for the Changed in fake ambulances.
You Slipped and saved them both. You got stuck. You lost four minutes. Mikey saw.
Jules walked down the frozen Parkway through four darts. Every one of them missed.
Bruno Iannucci came to Thanksgiving dinner. "After the holiday. Come see me. Alone."
Dr. Achterberg: "ES-17 is confirmed."
After the Parkway, you have a white hair. Grace says in places your body is thirty.
Bruno Iannucci paid for Teddy's mother's transplant evaluation. Teddy works for him now.
You work for him too. Eight jobs to clear Pop's debt.
Jules: "When I come back. In January. I ask, you answer."
Brannigan sat down with Bruno Iannucci and asked for an understanding.
Nonna lied. There was a boy: her brother, Salvatore. In 1961 he came back old, and died at the Feast at 11:51.
You have his watch. Nonna says in the cold it's the only thing that ticks.
Brannigan, at the Navy Yard gate: "When you get tired of being somebody's errand boy, I'm hiring."
At 11:51 on Christmas Eve, the bells at St. Monica's stopped for one second.
At Ravenscourt, Gran took Jules to the chapel and gave her three questions.
In the chapel, Jules rolled a die and didn't let it. It came up one.
At midnight on New Year's, the bells stopped for one second, for both of you. You asked if she heard them. She said yes.
Vinnie is Dante Iannucci's right hand now.
You gave Dana Fiorillo the Navy Yard. Off the record.
On the roof, on January 22, you and Jules told each other everything.
Teddy, Heck, and Bree went into Building 7 without you. The door was open.
Teddy Kowal died at the bottom of the dry dock at the Navy Yard. He was twenty.
Jules let it all go her way at the dry dock. Teddy slipped on ice nobody saw. She thinks her luck killed him.
Marisol Reyes is out. The man with your face sat by her bed every night. "Not you. You get to go home."
Jules saw a bed on the eighth floor made up for ES-44.
You told Bruno it was Halcyon. "Then they owe me a boy."
Halcyon has one frame of a man with a missing finger.
Bruno sat with Halina at Jefferson. He knows her surgeon.
You gave Bruno the map of Building 7.
One of Bruno's men was found on the bottom step of the dry dock with his hair gone white. Halcyon answered.
Dante: "Bring her to Sunday dinner at Grandpa's. In March."
You gave Jules the card. "Don't trust the lucky one." She kept it.
Valentine's Day. The first time. "It's just us."

femi_card.text: Femi's last message: "M.R. ALIVE. RM 714. THEY CALL YOU 17."

femi_changed.text: Femi Ojo was in the zone at 11:51. Since then, nobody notices him. You can.

femi_dead.text: Femi Ojo died alone outside your door, 9-14, on Halloween night, while the party went on around him. Halcyon's cleaners did it. You were on the roof.

femi_halcyon.text: Femi was in Halcyon's study. He was scared of them. He came to your door to tell you something, and they killed him for it.

femi_phone_read.text: On the night of the vigil, you texted Femi's phone. At 11:14 p.m., it said Read. Someone has it.

first_kiss.text: On Halloween, on the roof of Cardone Hall, at 11:47 p.m., you kissed Jules Pemberton. She was dressed as the Liberty Bell.

first_night.text: Valentine's Day, 2027, in 9-04, after the rink. The first time.

first_rewind.text: In the frozen moment, you failed, and time ran backward to give you another try. You failed again anyway.

gran_sam.text: Gran: "Some families are lucky. Some are early. The early ones always go in for somebody else. Keep him close, child, and don't let the house collect from him."

halcyon_aperture.text: Inside Halcyon, a screen read APERTURE, counting down to 11:51. Below it: SUBJECT FIELD 1.9 MI · CONTAINMENT NOMINAL.

halcyon_beds.text: Vinnie counted 41 hospital beds delivered to the basement of Halcyon's Navy Yard campus on Monday.

halcyon_clinic.text: Halcyon set up a "cooling clinic" tent in McPherson Square and lured Heck there with a text from Marisol's phone.

halcyon_outreach.text: A Halcyon man in a gray polo is asking RAs in the blackout zone to refer students with nosebleeds, migraines, or cold sensitivity. $500 a referral.

halcyon_tablet_man.text: A calm man from Halcyon in a gray polo swept Broad Street with a tablet after the light.

halina_moved_up.text: Halina Kowal's transplant evaluation was moved up to March 11. Dr. Feingold's office called. Bruno called ten minutes later.

heck_fire_grace.text: You told Grace a man who was on fire did this to you.

heck_heat.text: Heck runs hotter when the weather's hot. He can't turn it off.

hugh_visit.text: Hugh Pemberton came to Cardone Hall on March 4 to meet you. He brought Callum. He went into 9-04 alone.

jayden_cold_man.text: The boy, Jayden, called you "the cold man."

josiah_1876.text: Gran: when he was thirty-one, Josiah Pemberton stood beside a great engine when it stopped "for a heartbeat," and something stood beside him. He made an agreement he didn't understand. Every Pemberton since has been lucky.

jules_callum.text: Jules has a boyfriend: Callum Whitford, Penn Crew. He's nice. That's the problem.

jules_carmen.text: You told Jules about Carmen Torres. You said you were "too slow." You didn't say how fast you were.

jules_changed.text: Jules was changed in the Hitch.

jules_chapel.text: When Jules was seven, Hugh locked her in the family chapel at Ravenscourt overnight. In the dark, she could hear the house breathing. Gran found her in the morning: "Pembertons don't need to be afraid of the dark. The dark should be afraid of us." She has slept with a light on ever since.

jules_chose_temple.text: Jules says she's never broken a rule. That was the lie. She chose Temple, apparently over her mother's objections.

jules_covered.text: While Sam was under I-95, Rosa called Jules. Jules told her Sam had fallen asleep on the lounge couch with his calculus book on his face, and that she'd put a blanket on him.

jules_darts.text: On the Parkway, Jules walked down the middle of the frozen street through Halcyon's darts. Every one of them missed. Her nose was bleeding. You saw it, and you don't know what you saw.

jules_die_sixes.text: Jules's ivory die rolls nothing but sixes now.

jules_fall_test.text: At Ravenscourt, Jules let go of the reins over a four-foot wall to see what would happen. She landed on her feet. Mercutio didn't.

jules_fire.text: Jules knows you ran to the 15th Street fire to help. She doesn't know how you got there and back so fast.

jules_glass.text: The window came down on Jules in the Hitch, and every piece of glass missed her.

jules_handkerchief.text: You have Jules's handkerchief: white, ironed, JLP in navy thread. "Keep it."

jules_ivory_die.text: Jules carries an old ivory die from her grandmother. "It isn't lucky. Luck isn't real."

jules_light.text: Jules sleeps with a light on. She asked you to leave the desk lamp on. You didn't ask why.

jules_light_off.text: On the night of Teddy's funeral, in 9-14, Jules asked you to turn off the desk lamp. She sleeps with a light on. She didn't, that night.

jules_mifflin.text: Jules came to Sunday dinner on Mifflin Street.

jules_never_loses.text: Jules says she has never lost a game of cards. It was one of her truths.

jules_nothing_happens.text: Jules told you: "Nothing happens to me. I don't fall. I don't get hurt. Everyone calls it luck. I think it's the wrong word."

jules_parade.text: Jules will be in the sponsors' grandstand at the Art Museum steps on Thanksgiving morning. Her father's firm sponsors the parade.

jules_pop.text: Sam left the study night to help his father. He said he couldn't say more.

jules_saw_hurt.text: Jules saw you bleeding on the bathroom floor at 3 a.m. after Kensington. She saw the injuries.

jules_saw_nose2.text: Jules saw you bleed again in recitation, onto her handkerchief.

jules_text_whatif.text: At 12:58 a.m. on October 4, Jules texted you: "What if it was me." Nothing else.

jules_twin.text: Jules has a twin brother at Penn.

jules_two_sams.text: Jules saw Sam in two places at once on the ninth floor. One in a towel, one in his doorway.

kensington_shimmer.text: In the Slip, something over Kensington was moving. Nothing should move in the Slip.

lied_nik.text: You lied to Nik about the Slip. He didn't buy it.

lost_minutes.text: After the Girard job, you lost twenty-one minutes. You woke up on a curb on Ridge Avenue with frost on your sneakers.

lost_minutes2.text: You woke up on the Cardone roof at dawn with frost on your bare feet and no memory of going up there. Twenty-six minutes, gone.

luck_cost.text: Gran: the luck costs other people. "The house always collects. Not from us. Near us." Mercutio. Every time it goes your way, it goes someone else's way less.

man_across_street.text: A man across Broad Street had your face, older, scarred, missing his left ring finger. He put a finger to his lips. Then he was gone.

marisol.text: A Changed girl in Fishtown, Marisol Reyes, 19, could pop lightbulbs. She went to Halcyon's "wellness study" Tuesday. She never came home. Her mother got a text from her phone: "im fine staying w friends." Marisol never texts in lowercase.

mcpherson.text: Nik mapped it: the shimmer you saw in the Slip and the sound Bree heard come from the same place. The sky over McPherson Square, Kensington.

mikey_bree.text: On the Parkway, Mikey stopped a fake ambulance from taking Bree Kowal. He made them back off on live TV.

mikey_pop_dinner.text: Monday Oct 19: Mikey asked Pop about Dante Iannucci at the kitchen table. Pop told him, in front of Ma. At Sunday dinner on Oct 25, nobody ate.

mikey_sal.text: Mikey: Sal Russo, the Iannucci soldier with the white hair, is at Friends Hospital. He says "eleven fifty-one" and nothing else. Dante told the 3rd District it was a stroke.

mikey_task.text: Mikey has been assigned full-time to the PPD task group hunting the Broad Street Blur. A Halcyon consultant named Brannigan asked for him by name.

mutual_reveal.text: On the roof of Cardone Hall on January 22, you told each other everything.

nik_panic.text: Nik has panic attacks. He had one on the stairwell when he saw you bleeding.

nik_rutgers.text: Nik was going to transfer to Rutgers in the spring. He withdrew the application on November 2, so he wouldn't be "the guy who wasn't here."

nik_tracker.text: Nik built a map of every place in the city where people reported "the cold" since August. It clusters around Kensington, the Navy Yard, and Mifflin Street, with one odd point in Gladwyne.

nonna_felt.text: Nonna says she felt you "move" on Saturday night.

nonna_jacket.text: Nonna: "Saturday, near midnight, the clocks. Wear a jacket."

nonna_key.text: Nonna gave you an old iron key on a ribbon. "When it's time, I tell you what it opens."

owe_jules_favor.text: You owe Jules Pemberton one favor. Any favor. Her choosing, whenever she wants.

parade_freeze.text: At 9:41 on Thanksgiving morning, Teddy Kowal froze the Benjamin Franklin Parkway.

pop_call7.text: At 11:51 on March 12, Pop called just to say goodnight. He never calls.

pop_jacket.text: Vinnie saw Pop in a back booth at the Melrose Diner with a young guy in an expensive jacket.

pop_owes.text: Dante Iannucci told you: your father owes his family $41,000, from a bad bet in 2009. "Saturday is Saturday."

pop_unknown_calls.text: Pop keeps declining calls from the same unknown number: a 215 number ending in 4471.

revenant2.text: At dusk on Mifflin Street, the man who stands the way you stand waited under the streetlight at the end of the block. Nonna saw him too. She crossed herself.

revenant3.text: On the night after Halloween, at 3 a.m., Nonna saw the man who stands like you under the streetlight at the end of Mifflin Street. He was crying.

revenant5.text: In the Slip on the Parkway, the man who stands like you walked toward you between the frozen balloons. "You can't carry all of them." You said: "Watch me."

revenant_glimpse5.text: At the dry dock at 12:51, for one frame, across the water, you saw a gray-haired man with one hand raised, like a man at a window. Then Teddy fell.

revenant_note.text: On the back of Jules's index card, under "When I know, you'll be the first," someone wrote in your handwriting: "Don't trust the lucky one." You didn't write it.

revenant_ward.text: On the eighth floor of Building 7, an old woman, ES-03, woke long enough to say: "The old man comes at night. He sits with us. He has your face."

rewind_voluntary.text: You can rewind on purpose now. You reach for the moment you want back, and pull.

sal_white.text: One of Bruno's men was found on the bottom step of the dry dock with his hair gone white overnight, saying "eleven fifty-one." Halcyon answered.

salvatore_dinardo.text: Nonna's older brother was Salvatore DiNardo (1931–1961). He could do what you do, and he never learned to stop. In December 1961 he went in after three children at a fire on Arch Street and came back an old man. He died on Christmas Eve at 11:51. You are named for him.

sam_at_girard.text: Who knows you were at Broad & Girard during the robbery

sam_in_zone.text: Who knows you were in the blackout zone at 11:51 Saturday, felt the cold, and have bled since

sam_no_reply.text: Jules texted "What if it was me." You read it at 1:09 a.m. You never answered.

sam_number.text: Teddy and Bree have your number.

sam_slip.text: Your secret: when the world stopped, you didn't.

simone_list.text: Simone keeps a list on her phone about Jules, and one about Sam. Jules added a line: "8. She knows about this list."

simone_two_lists.text: Simone has two lists. One was about you. The other one, she says, "isn't mine to tell."

six_ambulances.text: Six ambulances without unit numbers, staged on the Parkway on Thanksgiving morning.

slip_rescue_pop.text: You Slipped and carried Pop away from Dante's men under I-95.

slip_rules.text: When you Slip: the world stops, it's freezing, you're starving after, and your nose bleeds.

stasis.text: The touching Gritty can stop things. A stopped thing isn't cold or warm. It isn't in time at all, even in the Slip. You couldn't move it.

tablet10.text: You took a Halcyon tablet off a fake medic on the Parkway. On it, a list. Your face, labeled 17. And faces you know.

teddy_darted.text: On the Parkway, Halcyon's fake medics darted Teddy Kowal. When his hand left the street, the ninety seconds started.

teddy_dead.text: Teddy Kowal died at the bottom of the dry dock at the Navy Yard at 12:53 a.m. on January 23. He was twenty.

teddy_face.text: You saw the face of the one who stops things: about twenty, pale, tired eyes, a chipped front tooth, a Band-Aid on his knuckles.

teddy_lost_40k.text: Teddy let go of Frank Kearney's cab under I-95 and walked away from the Iannucci job. $40,000, gone.

teddy_mother.text: Teddy's mother, Halina Kowal, needs a kidney. The robbery money is for her transplant evaluation at Jefferson.

teddy_name.text: The one who stops things is called Teddy. The big one with the burning hands is Heck.

teddy_number.text: You have Teddy's number. The deal: if Halcyon comes for one of you, you call the others.

thermal.text: Halcyon put thermal cameras on the Parkway lampposts. The Changed run cold. They're looking for cold.

tolu_nda.text: Halcyon offered Femi's sister Tolu $250,000 to sign an NDA about the study. She gave you his green notebook, "NOTES FOR SAM K."

tolu_truth.text: You told Femi's sister, Tolu, that it wasn't an accident.

unstick.text: Under I-95 you got stuck in the Slip. You couldn't get out. You found your own footprints in the frost at the river's edge and don't remember making them. You pulled yourself out thinking about Jules.

vinnie_dante.text: Vinnie drives nights for "Dante from Passyunk." Twelve hundred a week, cash.

watch.text: Salvatore DiNardo's pocket watch, stopped at 11:51. Nonna says in the Slip it's the only thing that ticks. Hold it, and walk toward it.

wawa_guy.text: A video of you at the Wawa on Broad went viral. The internet calls you WAWA GUY.

weisz_strange.text: Dr. Weisz told the class the Corliss Engine stopped "for a heartbeat" in 1876. After class he told you your edges were blurry.

whatif.text: On the stoop on Mifflin Street, Jules said your brother was looking for the Blur. You said, "What if it was?"

xray.text: The x-ray at Temple ER showed fractures that were ten days into healing. You broke them the night before.

recap.t: You moved into Cardone Hall, 9th floor. You carried a minifridge nobody asked you to carry.
At 11:51:04 on Saturday night, every clock in North Philadelphia stopped. You didn't.
You pulled a little boy named Jayden out from in front of the 16 bus. He called you "the cold man."
A nine-second video went viral. The internet calls you WAWA GUY.
A man across Broad Street put a finger to his lips. Then a bus passed, and he was gone.
You told Nik everything. He wants to be your guy in the chair.
You finally went to see Carmen Torres. She gave you a medal of Saint Jude, patron of lost causes.
Three people in Gritty masks robbed an armored truck at Broad & Girard. One of them could stop things just by touching them.
The Inquirer has a new name for you: the Broad Street Blur.
Since Saturday, nobody can see Femi Ojo. Except you.
A rowhouse burned at 15th & Lehigh. Halcyon's men were waiting with dart rifles.
The night the power went out on the ninth floor, you and Jules talked until the sun came up.
Then Callum came with iced coffee.
Halcyon lured Heck to McPherson Square. You fought him to bring him home, and you did.
For the first time, you rewound time on purpose.
Brannigan knows about the minute.
Jules stitched you up on the bathroom floor at 3 a.m.
Your x-ray showed ten days of healing. You broke it the night before.
Jules came to Sunday dinner on Mifflin Street. Nonna handed her the macaroni first.
Mikey is on the Blur task group now. Brannigan asked for him by name.
Vinnie drives nights for a man named Dante, from Passyunk.
A man who stands the way you do stood at the end of Mifflin Street. Nonna saw him too.
At Ravenscourt, Jules couldn't lose a hand of cards, no matter what she did.
A physicist named Dr. Achterberg asked where Jules was at 11:51 on August 22.
Callum said "I love you." Jules said it back.
In the chapel at Ravenscourt, Constance watched the die come up six, and said, "It's started, then."
Pop owes the Iannucci family $41,000. Dante says: by Thanksgiving.
Under I-95, you got your father away from Dante's men.
Jules lied to your mother for you.
Monday morning, Pop's cab was found with every window broken.
On Halloween, Halcyon's cleaners killed Femi Ojo.
He died alone outside your door while the party went on around him. You were on the roof.
You kissed Jules on the roof at 11:47. You didn't look at your phone.
Brannigan knows your name.
Femi's last message: "M.R. ALIVE. RM 714. THEY CALL YOU 17."
Femi's phone read your messages. Someone has it.
Simone knows. You lied when she gave you the chance.
Teddy is planning one last job. November 26.
On the back of Jules's index card, in your handwriting: "Don't trust the lucky one."
On Thanksgiving, Teddy Kowal froze the Parkway. Halcyon came for the Changed in fake ambulances.
You Slipped and saved them both. You got stuck. You lost four minutes. Mikey saw.
Jules walked down the frozen Parkway through four darts. Every one of them missed.
Bruno Iannucci came to Thanksgiving dinner. "After the holiday. Come see me. Alone."
Dr. Achterberg: "ES-17 is confirmed."
After the Parkway, you have a white hair. Grace says in places your body is thirty.
Bruno Iannucci paid for Teddy's mother's transplant evaluation. Teddy works for him now.
You work for him too. Eight jobs to clear Pop's debt.
Jules: "When I come back. In January. I ask, you answer."
Brannigan sat down with Bruno Iannucci and asked for an understanding.
Nonna lied. There was a boy: her brother, Salvatore. In 1961 he came back old, and died at the Feast at 11:51.
You have his watch. Nonna says in the cold it's the only thing that ticks.
Brannigan, at the Navy Yard gate: "When you get tired of being somebody's errand boy, I'm hiring."
At 11:51 on Christmas Eve, the bells at St. Monica's stopped for one second.
At Ravenscourt, Gran took Jules to the chapel and gave her three questions.
In the chapel, Jules rolled a die and didn't let it. It came up one.
At midnight on New Year's, the bells stopped for one second, for both of you. You asked if she heard them. She said yes.
Vinnie is Dante Iannucci's right hand now.
You gave Dana Fiorillo the Navy Yard. Off the record.
On the roof, on January 22, you and Jules told each other everything.
Teddy, Heck, and Bree went into Building 7 without you. The door was open.
Teddy Kowal died at the bottom of the dry dock at the Navy Yard. He was twenty.
Jules let it all go her way at the dry dock. Teddy slipped on ice nobody saw. She thinks her luck killed him.
Marisol Reyes is out. The man with your face sat by her bed every night. "Not you. You get to go home."
Jules saw a bed on the eighth floor made up for ES-44.
You told Bruno it was Halcyon. "Then they owe me a boy."
Halcyon has one frame of a man with a missing finger.
Bruno sat with Halina at Jefferson. He knows her surgeon.
You gave Bruno the map of Building 7.
One of Bruno's men was found on the bottom step of the dry dock with his hair gone white. Halcyon answered.
Dante: "Bring her to Sunday dinner at Grandpa's. In March."
You gave Jules the card. "Don't trust the lucky one." She kept it.
Valentine's Day. The first time. "It's just us."
Hugh came to Cardone Hall with Callum. He went into 9-04 alone.
Jules played cards for Bruno Iannucci. For Pier 53.
A split pot. Pop's debt is half paid. Bruno wants to see her play again.
The handkerchief is gone from Jules's coat. So is the card.
Ma wants you home Sunday. Alone.
